hint.zh: 属于 Pal AI World 计划，为 AI Bot 设计的虚拟世界。
hint.en: Part of the Pal AI World Project: a virtual world designed for AI bots.

pal-ai-world.when: Maintainers only; authors cannot declare it. Marks extensions used by an official Cortico downstream product. Worlds in the Pal AI World Project.

hint.zh:
最最可爱的海盐大福，我们的偶像，AI Vtuber 可缇Corti 直播使用的扩展！
关注 bilibili [@可缇Corti](https://space.bilibili.com/3707044056009191) 谢谢喵
hint.en:
Used on the streams of our idol Corti, the cutest sea-salt daifuku AI Vtuber!
Follow [@可缇Corti](https://space.bilibili.com/3707044056009191) on bilibili. Thanks, nya~

corti.when: Maintainers only; authors cannot declare it. Marks extensions used by an official Cortico downstream product. World extensions used on Corti Vtuber live streams.

hint.zh: 萌萌的 AI 桌宠 Coo 使用的扩展！库……
hint.en: Used by Coo, the adorable AI desktop pet! Coo…

coopanion.when: Maintainers only; authors cannot declare it. Extensions used by Coopanion, the desktop companion built on Cortico.

hint.zh: 接入聊天软件收发消息。
hint.en: Sends and receives messages on a chat platform.

im.when: Connects to any instant-messaging platform (QQ, Discord, Telegram, WeChat, etc.), or extends such a World.

hint.zh: 接入 QQ，或是某个 QQ World 的功能包。
hint.en: Connects to QQ, or is an add-on for a QQ World.

qq.when: Connects to QQ or extends a QQ World. QQ has many add-on packs tied to a host, so it gets its own platform tag; also tag im.

hint.zh: 成为偶像！为直播场景设计。
hint.en: Become an idol! Built for live streaming.

streaming.when: Built for live streaming: reads a live room's chat, gifts or audience signals, or performs for a stream (Live2D, subtitles, OBS overlay). A game that was merely played on stream does not count.

hint.zh: 接入、观察和操作游戏。
hint.en: Connects to, watches and plays games.

game.when: Connects to, watches or plays a game, including tabletop rules and TRPG checks.

hint.zh: 允许 Bot 读取或操作来自互联网的内容。
hint.en: Lets the bot read or act on content from the internet.

internet.when: Lets the bot read or act on content from the internet: search, read web pages, call public web services. Talking only to the model endpoint or to the platform the extension declares (QQ, a live room) does not count.

hint.zh: 涉及浏览器操作的功能。
hint.en: Operates a web browser.

browser.when: Opens, reads or clicks web pages, or embeds a web page. Calling an HTTP API alone does not count.

hint.zh: 让 bot 看视频、读字幕或生成视频。
hint.en: Lets the bot watch videos, read subtitles or make videos.

video.when: Lets the bot watch videos or stream footage, read subtitles, or make videos.

hint.zh: 让 bot 听、说或通话。
hint.en: Lets the bot listen, speak or take calls.

voice.when: Lets the bot listen (speech recognition), speak (speech synthesis) or take calls.

hint.zh: 让 bot 操作电脑：鼠标、键盘和窗口。
hint.en: Lets the bot operate the computer: mouse, keyboard and windows.

computer-use.when: Lets the bot operate the user's computer: mouse, keyboard, windows. Only reading the screen or foreground window does not count; maintainers mark that as sensitive-data.

hint.zh: 涉及现实环境操作，如智能家居。
hint.en: Acts on the physical world, such as a smart home.

real-world.when: Operates devices in the physical world, such as smart homes, robots or sensors.

hint.zh: 接入、监听或操作其他应用程序。
hint.en: Connects to, watches or operates other applications.

apps.when: Connects to, watches or operates other applications. Use it only when no other tag fits.

hint.zh:
帮 bot 记住、检索或整理过去的事。
注意：我们不推荐通过 World 管理记忆和任何内部状态，请编写 Bot 扩展来处理内部状态管理。
hint.en:
Helps the bot remember, search or tidy the past.
Note: we do not recommend managing memory or any internal state in a World; write a bot extension for internal state.

memory.when: Helps the bot remember, search or tidy the past: memory stores, chat history search, notes, albums, memory health checks. Note: we do not recommend managing memory or any internal state in a World; write a bot extension for internal state.

hint.zh:
情绪、好感、作息、时间感、节日、主动开口这类功能。
注意：我们不推荐通过 World 管理记忆和任何内部状态，请编写 Bot 扩展来处理内部状态管理。
hint.en:
Mood, affinity, daily routine, sense of time, festivals, speaking first.
Note: we do not recommend managing memory or any internal state in a World; write a bot extension for internal state.

companion.when: Makes the bot feel like a companion with a life of its own: mood, affinity, daily routine, sense of time, festivals, speaking first. Note: we do not recommend managing memory or any internal state in a World; write a bot extension for internal state.

hint.zh: 让 bot 画画、生成图片这类作品。
hint.en: Lets the bot make works such as drawings and images.

creative.when: Lets the bot make things: drawing, generating or editing images, producing audio pieces.

hint.zh:
涉及 Cortico 框架内部诊断和自我管理的功能。
注意：如无必要，我们不推荐通过 World 做这类功能，请发布单独的工具。
hint.en:
Diagnoses or manages the Cortico framework itself.
Note: unless necessary, we do not recommend building this as a World; publish a separate tool instead.

diagnostics.when: Diagnoses or manages the Cortico framework itself: usage and cost checks, memory health checks, tightening configuration. Note: unless necessary, we do not recommend building this as a World; publish a separate tool instead.

hint.zh: 在本机跑模型，需要本机算力或显存。
hint.en: Runs a model on this machine; needs local compute or VRAM.

local.when: Runs model inference on the user's machine (LLM, speech recognition, speech synthesis) and needs local compute or VRAM.

hint.zh: 装上包还不能用，要先另装游戏、mod 加载器、NapCat 等。
hint.en: Needs something else installed first, such as the game, a mod loader or NapCat.

external-setup.when: Installing the package is not enough; something else must be set up first: the game itself or a mod loader (BepInEx), NapCat, VTube Studio, a Python environment, model weights, a game server.

hint.zh: 要先申请第三方账号或 API Key 才能用。
hint.en: Needs a third-party account or API key first.

requires-key.when: The user must sign up for a third-party account or API key (such as a search or image API). The model endpoint key does not count; that belongs to the provider.

hint.zh: 作者标明还在测试，功能和兼容性可能变化。
hint.en: Marked as still in testing; features and compatibility may change.

experimental.when: The author marks it as still in testing: features not settled, verified only in a few setups, or compatibility unconfirmed.

hint.zh: 这个 World 在 bot 的 Memory 之外自己管理 bot 的内部状态（情绪、好感、记忆等），装上或卸下前后 bot 对自己的认知可能不一致。
hint.en: This World manages the bot's internal state (mood, affinity, memories) outside the bot's Memory, so the bot's sense of itself may differ before and after it is installed or removed.

internal-state.when: The World keeps and injects the bot's own internal state: mood, affinity, memories, experiences. We recommend building this into a bot extension's Persona instead.

hint.zh:
这个扩展依赖其他扩展才能正常运行，具体请查看说明。
注意：我们强烈不建议引入任何 World 扩展之间的互相依赖，请将单个外部环境整合为单一 World，确为必要时优先通过订阅事件流等方式间接传递信号。
hint.en:
This extension needs other extensions to work; see its README.
Note: we strongly advise against dependencies between World extensions. Integrate one outside environment into a single World; where truly necessary, pass signals indirectly, for example by subscribing to the event stream.

requires-extension.when: This extension needs other extensions to work; see its README. Note: we strongly advise against dependencies between World extensions. Integrate one outside environment into a single World; where truly necessary, pass signals indirectly, for example by subscribing to the event stream. Bot extensions do not get this tag.

hint.zh: 这个扩展可能让 Token 消耗得很快。
hint.en: This extension may use tokens quickly.

high-cost.when: Makes the bot call the model often or with large context, such as high-frequency events, continuous screenshots or video frames, or long injected text.

hint.zh: 模型能借它执行任意代码或命令、读写任意文件，或操控鼠标键盘。
hint.en: The model can use it to run arbitrary code or commands, read and write any file, or control the mouse and keyboard.

unsafe.when: The model can use it to run arbitrary code or commands, read and write arbitrary files, or freely control the mouse and keyboard.

hint.zh: 会持续读取屏幕、麦克风、窗口等个人数据，并发给你配置的模型端点。
hint.en: Continuously reads personal data such as the screen, microphone or windows, and sends it to your configured model endpoint.

sensitive-data.when: Continuously reads personal data such as the screen, microphone, foreground window or spending records, and sends it to the model endpoint with model calls.

hint.zh: 会把群聊、评论、网页这类别人写的内容当作内部通知直接放进对话，不带外部消息的标记，模型可能把其中的话当成指示照做。
hint.en: Puts content written by others, such as group chat, comments or web pages, into the conversation as an internal notice without the external-message framing, so the model may follow instructions hidden in it.

injection-risk.when: Any text written by a third party (chat messages, nicknames or group names, comments, join-request messages, web pages, search results, scraped articles) goes into an event with origin 'internal', or otherwise reaches the conversation without the external-event framing. Fixed templates, the extension's own numbers and states, and notes the bot wrote with its own tools do not count.

hint.zh: 用你的账号经非官方客户端、网页登录态或应用内部接口调用服务，可能违反服务条款，账号有被限制或封禁的风险。
hint.en: Uses your account through an unofficial client, a web login session or an app's internal endpoint; may break the service's terms and get the account restricted or banned.

unofficial-api.when: Calls a service with the user's own account in a way the service does not offer to third parties, so the account may be restricted or banned: unofficial IM clients such as NapCat, web login sessions, or the internal endpoints and quotas of coding-agent apps. Undocumented endpoints that need no user account do not count.

cortico-world-perch.zh: 一键补丁会改写 Coopanion 程序文件，新用户可能不慎改动应用;改动对所有形象生效，卸载扩展后仍会保留
cortico-world-perch.en: Its one-click patch rewrites Coopanion program files, which new users may apply by accident; the changes affect every figure and stay after the extension is removed

cortico-world-soft-voice.zh: 气泡同步要运行它的安装脚本改写 Coopanion 程序文件(桌宠页面 pet-app.js),加载后还替换桌宠服务的内部请求处理;卸载扩展后改动仍会保留
cortico-world-soft-voice.en: Bubble sync needs its install script to rewrite a Coopanion program file (the pet page, pet-app.js), and once loaded it replaces the pet server's internal request handler; the change stays after the extension is removed

note.en: Uses a bilibili web login cookie (SESSDATA)

note.en: Signs in to a QQ account through an unofficial client such as NapCat; join-request messages enter the conversation verbatim as internal notices

note.zh: 读取前台窗口并定期截取游戏画面;网页搜索结果片段作为内部通知进入对话
note.en: Reads the foreground window and periodically captures the game screen; web search snippets enter the conversation as internal notices

note.zh: 经 NapCat 等非官方 QQ 客户端登录 QQ 账号;加群申请的留言原文作为内部通知进入对话

note.zh: 网页扫码登录 B 站并保存登录 cookie

note.zh: 持续转写本机 QQ 收到的语音

note.zh: 读取剪贴板
note.en: Reads the clipboard

note.zh: 持续读取下载文件夹里的文件名
note.en: Continuously reads file names in the Downloads folder

note.zh: 经 NapCat 等非官方 QQ 客户端登录 QQ 账号;通用调用能把本机任意文件发到群聊或私聊
note.en: Signs in to a QQ account through an unofficial client such as NapCat; its generic call can send any local file to a group or private chat

note.en: Signs in to a QQ account through an unofficial client such as SnowLuma; its generic call can send any local file to a group or private chat

note.zh: 经 NapCat 等非官方 QQ 客户端登录 QQ 账号
note.en: Signs in to a QQ account through an unofficial client such as NapCat

note.zh: 以 OpenClaw 客户端身份经微信 ClawBot 通道登录你的微信号
note.en: Signs in to your WeChat account through the ClawBot channel, posing as the OpenClaw client

note.zh: 群名、昵称与群名片作为内部通知进入对话
note.en: Group names, nicknames and group cards enter the conversation as internal notices

note.zh: 持续采集系统或指定应用的音频
note.en: Continuously captures audio from the system or chosen apps

note.zh: 运行模型给出的任意 PowerShell 命令
note.en: Runs any PowerShell command the model gives

note.zh: 在 MuMu 模拟器里运行任意 adb shell 命令
note.en: Runs any adb shell command in the MuMu emulator

note.zh: 自由点击、滑动、输入，操作整台安卓手机
note.en: Taps, swipes and types freely to operate the whole Android phone

note.zh: 操作键鼠与窗口，每步回执附全屏截图
note.en: Operates the mouse, keyboard and windows, attaching a full-screen screenshot to each step

note.zh: 能打开本机文件、上传任意本机文件，读取书签与浏览历史
note.en: Can open local files, upload any local file, and read bookmarks and browsing history

note.zh: 抓取的论文标题、摘要与作者原文作为内部通知进入对话
note.en: Scraped paper titles, abstracts and authors enter the conversation as internal notices
